# Getting help with PAT

Start with the [README](../README.md) and [user guide](../docs/PROJECT_ASSESS.md).
The guide covers source scans, reviews, goals, badges, agent connections and
[local-state recovery](../docs/PROJECT_ASSESS.md#local-state-and-updates).

For a question, bug or feature idea, [search existing issues](https://github.com/gburch/project-assessment-toolkit/issues)
and open an issue if needed. Include the PAT version or commit, your operating
system and a small synthetic example when relevant. Suggestions grounded in a
real use case help keep the tool proportional to the work it supports.

Public issues and pull requests should contain no private source, local-state
exports or credentials. For vulnerabilities, follow the private reporting route
in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). For contribution setup, see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
